answer_1.quote: We evaluate the performance of the model on language capabilities: perplexity, a metric also utilized by prior works. We conducted tests on the perplexity metric using Wiki-Text and the c4 dataset. To enhance the evaluation of LLMs, we use the Language Model Evaluation Harness to assess performance on 5 zero-shot tasks of models: HellaSwag, PIQA, WinoGrande, OpenBookQA, RTE.
answer_1.outputs: Model predictions (perplexity scores and answers for zero-shot tasks)
